messages:
maya: APAC GPU provisioning started failing ~10m ago after the KMS policy change. New errors show KMS AccessDenied and VM boot volumes failing. Anyone on this?
ops-bot: [alert] ap-southeast-1: gpu-provisioning-failure x3 nodes. Runbook: https://rountrun.internal/runbooks/gpu-provisioning 
liam: seeing IAM assume-role errors too. bootstrap logs: 'Failed to attach volume: AccessDenied' then 'Could not decrypt with KMS key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789:key/abcd-efgh'
jon: did the security PR accidentally block principals from peered VPCs? @security-bot can you confirm which principals were removed in the key policy?
security-bot: We applied PR #6321 to tighten KMS usage per compliance. Policy limited allowed principals to the infra account only (account:987654321). Not intended to deny peered-account service principals. Investigating now.
sophia: short-term: we can fallback provisioning to EU pool, but that will increase cost and add latency. Also we could temporarily re-add cross-account principal in the KMS policy as a hotfix.
liam: example error when creating a volume: ```
$ aws ec2 create-volume --size 200 --availability-zone ap-southeast-1a --encrypted --kms-key-id alias/redwood-gpu
An error occurred (UnauthorizedOperation) when calling the CreateVolume operation: Not authorized to use the key
```
maya: autoscaler shows many pods Pending because PVs not attaching. APAC GPU capacity shows Unhealthy. We should either rollback the KMS change or failover to EU ASAP. Tagging @oncall.
jon: if we revert, make sure we add a unit test for KMS policy that checks peered-principal allowance. Reverting is lowest blast radius. @security-bot any ETA?
security-bot: Initiating partial rollback of PR #6321 (remove the restrictive statement). Rollback started, ETA ~6 minutes. Will post status.
ops-bot: Deploy: rollback triggered by security-bot. Status: in-progress.
liam: 4m after rollback started — volume creation succeeded for one node 
  "createdVolume": "vol-0a1b2c3d", 
  "status": "available"
maya: Confirming: autoscaler now attaching volumes and nodes marked Ready. APAC pool recovering. Please keep monitoring for 15m.
sophia: Post-incident action items: 1) Add KMS policy validation to infra ci (check peered and cross-account service principals); 2) Add runbook step to failover provisioning to EU with traffic-shed policy; 3) Cost reconciliation — we spilled to EU for ~2 hours, estimate ~$4k extra.
jon: I'll open the follow-up tickets and link the incident doc. Also propose a smoke test that runs a create-volume with the new key policy against a sandbox peered VPC.
maya: thanks all. Closing when incident doc is up: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-042.
security-bot: Note: we've queued an audit log action to list KMS policy changes and notify compliance.
maya: 👍 will add postmortem and owner (maya) to the ticket.
